mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 72-degree temperatures around Harriet Park. We have a full moon gracing us tonight as well.

September is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona, focusing on nutrition security for our residents, and September 1 is designated as Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to recognize our local safety guardians.
The Dane County Farmers Market is happening today at the Capitol, and tomorrow features the Verona Area Kids Triathlon at the high school alongside a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Ice Arena.
On August 19, the Verona Police Department responded to a two-vehicle collision at North Main Street and Bering Drive, resulting in citations for both drivers involved.
The flavor of the day is Mint Explosion, and you can stop by anytime before the store closes at 10:30 PM to enjoy a serving.
